## Load libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # for dplyr, tidyr, and ggplot2
library(patchwork)

```

## Make custom palettes
```{r palettes}

palette <- c("#117733", "#DDCC77", "#CC6677", "#88CCEE", "#332288")

palette2 <- c("#009e73", "#f0e442", "#cc79a7", "#0072b2", "#d55e00")

```

## Tell R not to use scientific notation 
```{r}

options(scipen = 999)

```
## Loading Raw Data
```{r}
fish.raw <- read.csv("NeuromastCounts6.csv")
fish.raw
```

## Summary statistics, Cleaning Data, and Calculating Percents
``` {r}
# SH = superficial head, ST = superficial trunk, CH = canal head, CT = canal trunk

fish.clean <- fish.raw %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Super_HeadNum)) %>% 
  filter_out(Treatment == "0.002% 48h")

fish.num <- fish.clean %>% select(-c(Individual, Body_Length, Total)) %>%
  rename(SH.raw = Super_HeadNum,
         ST.raw = Super_TrunkNum,
         CH.raw = Canal_HeadNum,
         CT.raw = Canal_TrunkNum
         )
fish.num


fish.avgs <- fish.num %>% filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(SH.means = mean(SH.raw),
            ST.means = mean(ST.raw),
            CH.means = mean(CH.raw),
            CT.means = mean(CT.raw))
fish.avgs


fish.map <- fish.num %>% 
  left_join(fish.avgs, by = "Species")
fish.map


# ~ is shorthand for making a new function, .x is a placeholder for the thing being currently processed
fish.cent <- fish.map %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = ends_with(".raw"), # selecting the target columns
    .fns = ~ round(.x / get(str_replace(cur_column(), ".raw", ".means")) * 100, 2),
    .names = "percent.{.col}"
    ),
    
    .keep = "unused"
    ) %>%
    
    rename(`SH` = percent.SH.raw,
           `ST` = percent.ST.raw,
           `CH` = percent.CH.raw,
           `CT` = percent.CT.raw
           )

fish.cent
```
## The Plots >:)
```{r}
#Ordering Labels
fish.cent$Treatment <- factor(fish.cent$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "0.001%", "0.002%", "0.003%"))
fish.cent$Species <- factor(fish.cent$Species, levels = c("Giant_Danio", "Zebrafish", "Cherry_Barb", "Neon_Tetra", "Black_Tetra"))


# printing the four plots
for (var.col in c("SH", "ST", "CH", "CT" )) {
  
    var.cent <- fish.cent %>% select(c(Species, Treatment, sym(var.col)))
    var.sum <- var.cent %>% group_by(Species, Treatment) %>%
      summarize(
        mean = mean(!!sym(var.col)),
        sd = sd(!!sym(var.col)), .groups = "drop_last"
      )
   
    
    var.plot <- ggplot(var.sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, color = Species)) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_point(data = var.cent, 
                 aes(y = !!sym(var.col)), 
                 size = 0.5, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
                 alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                    width = 0.2, 
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = palette2) +
      labs(x = "Dose", y = paste0("% of Mean ", var.col, " Control Neuomasts")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
            plot.tag = element_text(size = 10))
    
   assign(str_glue('{var.col}.plot'), var.plot) 
   
  }

fullplot <- ((SH.plot | ST.plot) / (CH.plot | CT.plot))
fullplot <- fullplot + 
            plot_layout(guides = 'collect') +
            plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

fullplot

```

fullcountplot

## Calculations for percent neuromasts grouped
```{r}
# CALCULATIONS
total.num <- fish.clean %>% select(-c(Individual, Body_Length, Super_HeadNum, Super_TrunkNum, Canal_HeadNum, Canal_TrunkNum))

total.num$Treatment <- factor(total.num$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "0.001%", "0.002%", "0.003%"))
total.num$Species <- factor(total.num$Species, levels = c("Giant_Danio", "Zebrafish", "Cherry_Barb", "Neon_Tetra", "Black_Tetra"))

total.avgs <- total.num %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Control") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarize(total.means = mean(Total))

total.map <- total.num %>%
  left_join(total.avgs, by = "Species")

total.cent <- total.map %>%
  mutate('%_of_Control' = Total/total.means*100,
         .keep = "unused")
```

# MAKING THE PLOT
```{r total percent plot}
total.sum <- total.cent %>% group_by(Species, Treatment) %>%
      summarize(
        mean = mean(`%_of_Control`),
        sd = sd(`%_of_Control`), 
        .groups = "drop_last")
    
total.plot <- ggplot(total.sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, color = Species)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_line(aes(group=Species), # adds line across points
                position = position_dodge(width=0.5),
                alpha=0.7)+
      geom_point(data = total.cent, 
                 aes(y = `%_of_Control`), 
                 size = 1.3, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), 
                 alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), 
                    width = 0.1, 
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 10,linetype = "dashed")+
      scale_color_manual(values = palette2) +
      labs(x = "Dose", y = "Total neuromasts (%)") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
            plot.tag = element_text(size = 10),
            panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.8), # vertical lines
            panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.8), # horizontal
            legend.position = "top")

total.plot

```

    dpi = 600)
